artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, tan, and ochre
artworks.description: The image shows four figures: three standing and one reclining on a light blue surface. The reclining figure is partially clothed and has a crown of thorns on their head. The standing figures have halos above their heads, with distinct facial features and hairstyles. One is leaning over the reclining figure, one has curly hair and wears a robe, and the other wears a blue garment with tied back hair. All are dressed in earthy-toned robes. In the background is a cross-like structure, and the composition is framed with a border against a muted tan background.

artworks.title: Christ Appearing to Mary Magdalene
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in maroon, orange, yellow, blue-green, mauve, and flesh on laid paper, possibly applied with stencils
artworks.description: The image features two figures in an outdoor setting. One person is kneeling, facing right, with long hair partly covered by a veil or headscarf, wearing a long robe with a cloak, holding a small jar. The other person stands facing left, one arm slightly extended towards the kneeling figure, with long hair and a beard, wearing a robe that exposes the chest. A tree separates them, with lush foliage at the top. Structures resembling buildings or towers can be seen in the background. At the bottom, there is a band of text.

artworks.title: Christ Appearing to Mary Magdalene
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, gray, olive, red lake, and gold
artworks.description: The figures are depicted from head to toe. One figure stands on the left, holding a staff with a cross and a banner. The other figure kneels on the ground next to the standing figure. Both figures have long hair, wear robes, and have dark haloes around their heads. The background shows a fenced area with horizontal structures, green patches, and a plain sky.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, yellow, tan, and orange
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene involving a figure lying in a sarcophagus, attended by two other figures. The central figure appears to be resting in a rectangular structure. The structure is painted in a reddish tone and rests on a green base. The two figures nearby have flat, halo-like shapes. The background features simple architectural elements in yellow. The painting shows a stylized and flat representation typical of religious iconography.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, yellow, tan, and orange
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, both depicted from the waist up. The person in the foreground is positioned slightly bent forward, holding a large yellow cross over their right shoulder. This individual has long, flowing hair tinted with brown and orange hues, partially covered by a green and yellow headdress. This person is dressed in a long gray robe. The second figure, slightly behind and to the left, stands upright and wears a red garment with a yellow belt or sash. This person has short brown hair. The background consists of a light tan-colored surface with a section of green at the bottom. The illustration is bordered by a rough black outline.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, yellow, tan, and orange
artworks.description: The image shows three figures depicted in an illustrative, stylized form. The central figure stands facing forward with a halo around their head. They have short, dark hair and notable features and are partially unclothed. The figure wears a yellow garment from the waist down and has red markings on their skin. Flanking the central figure are two other figures wearing tunics; one is in gray and yellow with stripes on their tunic, yellow leggings, and holding a green object, while the other wears a red tunic with beige leggings and is looking towards the central figure. In the background, there is a green patch underfoot and lines suggesting script or decoration along the top edge in dark ink.

artworks.title: Christ before Herod
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, yellow, tan, and orange
artworks.description: The image features two stylized and colorful figures. One standing person has light-colored hair, a yellow halo, and is dressed in yellow and green. They have a mustache and prominent eyes. The seated person wears red with black accents, a yellow crown, and dark hair. Their hands are gesturing outward. The background shows a simple textured surface with vertical decorative elements at the top and a green area at the bottom.

artworks.title: Caiaphas Tearing his Clothes
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, dark green, yellow, gray-blue, and gold
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people standing together. Some are wearing long robes of various colors. One central figure wearing a halo is slightly bent forward, surrounded by others. Others in the group are holding items or spears. On the right side, a person in a red robe and hat stands on a platform facing the others. The background is a simple landscape with green ground and a beige sky bordered by a red frame.

artworks.title: The Crowning with Thorns
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, green, yellow, gray-blue, and gold
artworks.description:
This is a painting of a seated figure with two standing figures, each holding tools or weapons. The central figure is seated on a simple bench set within an arched niche or space. The seated figure's head is bowed slightly. The two figures flanking the central one hold long sticks, rods, or spears that intersect above the central figure's head. 

The illustration uses bold, dark line work and limited color fills of red, teal, and green. The scene is framed within a red boundary that follows the square shape of the work, with additional rectangle partitions. This could be a single image from a series exploring narrative themes or moral stories.

The style is reminiscent of medieval European religious or allegorical art.

artworks.title: Christ Appearing to the Apostles
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in venetian red, green, lavender, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows four people in a stylized, illustrated form. Three figures on the right side face left, with their bodies turned towards the central figure on the left. The central figure on the left sits atop a cloud, holding a crucifer with their right hand raised. All figures have halos, defined features, and wear flowing robes in shades of earth tones. Linear patterns denote hair and beards. The background is minimally detailed with solid colors like green for the ground and beige for the sky or back wall. The scene is on textured paper with a simple illustrative style.

artworks.title: Last Judgment
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in Venetian red, green, yellow, and lavender
artworks.description: This is a painting of a central skeletal figure with a crown and two figures, one on each side, with halos. The image depicts a skeletal, crowned figure seated in the center, draped in pink and green fabric, and holding a long-stemmed flower in one hand. The figure is flanked by two other haloed figures, one cloaked in purple and the other in yellow, both kneeling in reverence. Additionally, two small skulls are positioned at the base of the central figure’s seat. The style uses bold outlines and vibrant colors reminiscent of religious iconography.

artworks.title: The Holy Ghost
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in yellow, lavender, and rose
artworks.description: This is a painting of a stylized bird with a halo. The bird is in the center of the image with outstretched wings, rendered in a linear, geometric style with zigzag patterns. The bird's head is crowned with a halo depicted as a circular shape with radiating lines. Below the bird, there are flower-like forms with layered petals in pink and purple, surrounded by yellow streaks. The background is a neutral beige.

artworks.title: Christ Child with Three Angels
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, venetian red, yellow, and lavender
artworks.description: This is a painting of a seated figure with a halo and a group of winged figures. The main figure is seated on a throne-like structure, holding an orb and raising a hand. This figure has a halo depicted with linear segments. Surrounding this figure are three winged figures, likely angels, clad in colorful robes and wings. They appear to be in a posture of reverence or prayer. The background is simplistic with a green area at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Resurrection of the Dead
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, blue, green, gray, and gold
artworks.description: This is a painting of angelic figures blowing trumpets above a group of people. The image features two winged figures depicted with stylized robes in colors such as green and orange. They hold large trumpets and are positioned in the upper part of the painting. Below them, a group of human-like figures appears in a state of attention or reverence. The composition has a naive and linear quality, with bold outlines and a simple color palette. The texture and color scheme suggest the piece is aged.

artworks.title: Confession
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in rose, green, venetian red, lavender, and yellow
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene featuring a figure seated wearing a mitre, with another figure in a robe beside them. To their right stands a winged figure holding a staff. The figure's wings are detailed and green. The style of the drawing is defined by bold outlines and color blocking. The color scheme includes green, brown, and purple against a plain background.

artworks.title: Christ Measuring the Globe
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in venetian red, lavender, yellow, and green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a cosmic scene with a large circular depiction of a cosmological concept. Inside the circle is a smaller circle containing a stylized city landscape with buildings. Surrounding the inner circle are celestial elements like a sun, crescent moon, and stars. There is a figure to the right holding a stick pointing towards the center. The figure is dressed in traditional robes with red and pink hues and a halo. The color palette is limited to yellow, green, pink, and black. The style resembles an illuminated medieval manuscript or early woodcut print from historical religious or mystical iconography.

artworks.title: Saint Peter as Founder of the Church
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in venetian red, green, yellow, lavender, and rose
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing close to a stylized architectural structure resembling a church or a cathedral with towers featuring green roofs and rectangular windows. The person on the left is wearing a golden crown with a cross on top and a halo in a green hue. This individual is dressed in a purple robe and is holding a golden key in their right hand. The person on the right has a round hairstyle, typical of a tonsure, and is wearing an ornate robe with visible striped patterns. This person is holding a cup in the right hand. The background features a simple architectural setting with a roof pattern in brown and green hues set against a plain wall, all outlined in black lines.

artworks.title: The Descent of the Holy Ghost
artworks.medium: woodcut with hand coloring in tan, brown, orange-red, green, rose, red lake, blue, and gold on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people sitting closely in a circular arrangement with one central figure in the forefront. The individuals have halos around their heads and stylized facial features. The central figure wears prominently draped garments, and the surrounding figures wear similar garments in varying colors. The figures have wavy hair mostly covered by the halos. A dove descends from a cloud above them. The background features a geometric pattern on the floor and the scene is framed with decorative borders of flowers and zigzag patterns.

artworks.title: The Descent of the Holy Ghost
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, blue, green, gray, and gold
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people seated closely together in a semi-circle around a central figure holding a book. The figures have simplified facial features and varied hair colors. The central figure wears a blue robe, while the others are dressed in different colors with halo-like shapes above their heads. Each person has a small flame above their head. The background features a stylized upper section with a dove-like bird spreading its wings. The scene is enclosed within a red and orange border, with a green floor and linear patterns indicating a wall in the background.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment with the Apostles
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, ochre, green, brown, tan, and black
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a heavenly judgment scene. The central figure is seated on a throne, surrounded by individuals with halos. Below them, there is a city with gates, and two groups of people are being guided. Architectural elements and possibly resurrected figures are also present. The color palette includes reds, greens, and tan shades, with strong outlines. The style is reminiscent of medieval Christian art such as illuminated manuscripts or altarpieces.

artworks.title: Last Judgment
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue-green, orange, yellow, rose, blue, and silver
artworks.description: The image depicts a central figure seated in the sky with two kneeling figures below, as well as two partially submerged figures. The central figure has flowing hair, a bearded face, and wears a green and orange robe. They hold a lily and a cross, with visible ribs suggesting death or resurrection themes. The kneeling figures on a green hill have halos and wear robes, with one figure clean-shaven and in white attire, and the other bearded, wearing yellow and brown cloak. Two smaller figures in rectangular boxes appear to be rising with hands held in a prayer gesture. The background is beige with a hint of blue at the top, enclosed in a thin red border.

artworks.title: The Flagellation in the Presence of Mary
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, rose, yellow-orange, green, and tan
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in an interior scene, one tied to a column. There is a column in the center with a person tied to it, surrounded by another figure with a raised tool. The setting appears to be inside a structured room with a tiled floor, and there is a window with an observer behind it. The figures are drawn with classical attire, with one character associated with religious iconography. The scene is rendered with clear outlines and colored sections, with a limited color palette highlighting important details. Angled lines in the background may indicate a sense of space or light.

artworks.title: The Preparation for the Crucifixion
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, green, brown, and yellow
artworks.description: This is a painting of multiple figures in a stylized form. The painting depicts individuals interacting around a large wooden cross-like structure. One figure is seated with red markings on their body. The scene is set in a lush green environment and some figures wear red attire and headdresses. Bold colors like red and green are used, and the figures are outlined with black lines against a neutral background. The style is reminiscent of medieval manuscript illumination or early Renaissance art.

artworks.title: The Death of the Virgin
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in light orange-red, green, yellow, and brown
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene featuring a central reclining figure on a bed, surrounded by other figures. The central figure has a halo and is on a bed draped with greenish-blue fabric. Other figures with halos, wearing robes, are also present, some holding books or objects. A smaller figure at the bottom is knelt in a pose of prayer. There are architectural elements like a bed with a tall headboard and a cross symbol. Above, two smaller figures are in a cloud. The style is reminiscent of unknown medieval manuscript artists, with flat forms and an earthy color palette dominated by red, brown, and green.
